title: FREIA：基于自由能驱动的自适应优势塑造的无监督强化学习算法用于LLM推理
summary: FREIA是一种新型无监督强化学习算法，通过自由能驱动奖励（FER）和自适应优势塑造（AAS）两项创新，自适应调整奖励和学习信号，提升LLM在无监督环境下的推理能力。在数学推理任务中，使用DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B模型，Pass@1指标平均提升0.5至3.5个百分点。
summary_en: FREIA is a novel unsupervised RL algorithm for LLMs, featuring Free Energy-Driven Reward (FER) and Adaptive Advantage Shaping (AAS). It adaptively adjusts rewards and learning signals, outperforming baselines on three reasoning tasks. On math reasoning, it improves Pass@1 by 0.5-3.5 points using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B.
